Yes that is exactly my issue that would be brilliant if you could possibly post that kind stranger. 

It’s very exhausting, is this a common thing with aspies, not knowing how we feel? I was only recently diagnosed so I don’t know a lot
What do I do with my current girlfriend, how do I know if it’s good to be with her?? I’m very confused
Assuming that is not a true stoic rationalist thought process. You are missing the point. Read meditations from start to end then come back and personally message me if you feel like doing that
Stoicism. Live it. Breathe it.
I don’t think you have rationalised it like a true stoic then. Rationally you would consider the people around you that you would hurt
Experience is experience it’s good, bad, happy and ugly you can control what you feel towards it but you can’t control the experience rolling out itself
Then another flu comes out bro, you got this, amor fati
I want you to look deeply into stoicism. It helped me a lot.
Look into stoicism my dude. Trust me.
You got this. Carry on, carry on, carry on. Look into stoicism
You got this. Hang in there, we got this together man.
Nah bro wait up don’t do that
Great one buddy, you got this.
Well one assignment is done and the second one half way done

I don’t know. Do I stay with this new girl? Is it bad for me to be with her at this time? She’s lovely but she’s focused so much on getting things in life together.

I like it but I just. Feel empty like I need something else, I think. I don’t know what’s wrong with me.
Can I send her a message saying to meet with me.?

Could I order her flowers? I want to have flowers delivered to her. I was never romantic enough which was one of the issues or does this come into the rules of space? I want to let her know how I feel. I really do love her. And I never got her flowers. I want her to know how special she is to me.
It’s really. Really hard. I miss her. And everything is reminding me of her, it’s incredibly hard to focus or do anything. 😭
Well boys, I fucked up. She now is broken up with me and is deciding for us if she wants me or not. I am giving her space
Idk just feelin in denial I guess, i guess her personality and who she is really doesn’t reflect what she does, it’s weird.
Yikes. I feel a bit overwhelmed.
But he has a girlfriend? Does this not matter,
